findings.description: AWS access key ID and secret access key are embedded in plaintext in the Lambda environment variables. Environment variables are visible to anyone with lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration and are stored unencrypted (no KMS key configured), so the long-lived credentials are exposed and cannot be rotated without a redeploy.
The function uses runtime nodejs12.x, which is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches, leaving known vulnerabilities in the runtime unaddressed.
